name: Volkl Revolt 87 Skis
description: Volkl themselves calls the Revolt 87 for competition freestyle skis. And with its narrow 87mm waist, twin tips, carbon strings and full-length sidewalls there is something about that term. These freestyle skis are perfect for pushing the boundaries in the park in the resort. Suitable for 70% park and 30% on piste Binding: Not included Notice: When purchasing both skis and bindings from us, we mount your bindings for free. If you want us to mount and adjust the bindings please type in the information at Checkout.
